subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <type_traits> header.
legend_blurb: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <type_traits> header.

symbols.name: integral_constant
symbols.notes: Foundation: holds compile-time value. ::value out-of-class for ODR safety.

symbols.name: bool_constant
symbols.failure_reason: Alias templates introduced in C++11; cannot shim further.

symbols.name: type_identity
symbols.notes: Trivial passthrough; blocks template argument deduction.

symbols.name: remove_pointer
symbols.notes: Strips one level of pointer (handles cv-qualified pointers).

symbols.name: remove_reference
symbols.notes: Strips lvalue and rvalue refs (rvalue path C++11+).

symbols.name: add_pointer
symbols.notes: Strips ref then adds *. void/cv-void handled.

symbols.name: add_rvalue_reference
symbols.notes: Yields T&&. Pure passthrough on C++98/03 (no rvalue refs).

symbols.name: make_signed
symbols.notes: Maps integral types to signed equivalents. Cv-preserving. Enum / floating-point not handled.
symbols.failure_reason: Enum mapping requires __underlying_type intrinsic; plain integers and char/wchar handled portably.

symbols.name: make_unsigned
symbols.notes: Maps integral types to unsigned equivalents. Cv-preserving.

symbols.name: is_integral
symbols.notes: Explicit specs across C++98/11/20 tiers (long long, char16/32_t, char8_t).

symbols.name: is_floating_point
symbols.notes: float, double, long double + cv flavors.

symbols.name: is_enum
symbols.notes: Compiler intrinsic. Falls back to false_type when absent.

symbols.name: is_union
symbols.notes: No portable detection. Falls back to false_type.

symbols.name: is_class
symbols.notes: Compiler intrinsic preferred. SFINAE-on-pmf trick exists but fails for unions on some compilers.

symbols.name: is_function
symbols.notes: Variadic specs on C++11+. Explicit arities 0-10 on C++98/03.

symbols.name: is_fundamental
symbols.notes: arithmetic + void + nullptr_t (nullptr_t gated on C++11+).

symbols.name: is_signed
symbols.notes: Uses static_cast<T>(-1) < 0 probe; gated on arithmetic.

symbols.name: is_unsigned
symbols.notes: Uses static_cast<T>(0) < static_cast<T>(-1) probe; gated on integral.

symbols.name: is_empty
symbols.notes: EBO test possible but unreliable; intrinsic preferred.

symbols.name: is_final
symbols.notes: final keyword is C++11; trait is C++14.

symbols.name: is_base_of
symbols.notes: Portable fallback via pointer-conversion overload set.

symbols.name: is_convertible
symbols.notes: C++11+ portable fallback via SFINAE; degrades to is_same on C++98/03.
symbols.failure_reason: Full convertibility detection requires declval + decltype.

symbols.name: underlying_type
symbols.notes: INTRINSIC REQUIRED. Trait omitted when intrinsic absent.
symbols.failure_reason: No portable C++ implementation possible without the intrinsic.

symbols.name: aligned_storage
symbols.notes: POD storage struct of given size and alignment. Default alignment via local fundamental-types union (avoids std::max_align_t dependency). Deprecated by std in C++23 (P1413R3); restd retains.

symbols.name: aligned_union
symbols.notes: Storage for any of Types..., size = max(Len, sizeof(Types)...), alignment = max(alignof(Types)...). Exposes alignment_value member.

symbols.name: common_type
symbols.notes: Conditional-expression-based common type. Includes the P0898R3 const-lvalue-ref fallback rule from C++20, applied on all C++11+ tiers.

symbols.name: basic_common_reference
symbols.notes: Customization-point primary template for common_reference. Empty body by default; users specialize. Backported to C++11+; needs only template-template parameters.
symbols.failure_reason: None on the trait itself (template-template parameters are C++98). Restd backports the trait's presence; the wider common_reference machinery is C++11+.

symbols.name: common_reference
symbols.notes: C++20 generalization of common_type that preserves reference qualifiers. Four-bullet chain: COMMON-REF, basic_common_reference, common_type, COND-RES.
symbols.failure_reason: Requires alias templates (gated on D_ENV_CPP_FEATURE_LANG_ALIAS_TEMPLATES; C++11+).

symbols.name: invoke_result
symbols.notes: Result type of INVOKE(F, Args...). Internal invoker dispatcher hosts the five INVOKE forms; reference_wrapper handling deferred until restd::reference_wrapper lands.
symbols.failure_reason: Requires decltype + variadic templates + trailing return types + enable_if-in-return-position (C++11+). Reference_wrapper invocation form (1.5) pending.

symbols.name: result_of
symbols.notes: Function-call-syntax sibling of invoke_result. Deprecated by std in C++17, removed in C++20; restd retains on all C++11+ tiers per project policy. Inherits SFINAE-friendliness from invoke_result.
symbols.failure_reason: Inherits invoke_result's C++11 floor (decltype + variadic templates).

symbols.name: is_invocable
symbols.notes: void_t SFINAE probe over invoke_result. Single source of truth for "is INVOKE well-formed".

symbols.name: is_invocable_r
symbols.notes: Two-step gate: is_invocable, then is_convertible to R (with R=void short-circuit).

symbols.name: is_nothrow_invocable
symbols.notes: Direct dispatcher noexcept-probe (invoke_result captures only type). Two-step gate via is_invocable.

symbols.name: is_nothrow_invocable_r
symbols.notes: Three-piece check: is_invocable_r, dispatcher noexcept, is_nothrow_convertible (with R=void short-circuit).

symbols.name: is_nothrow_convertible
symbols.notes: noexcept-of-conversion probe via internal noexcept "implicit_takes" function. Two-step gate via is_convertible. Backported to C++11+.

symbols.name: is_swappable
symbols.notes: Forwards add_lvalue_reference<T>::type to is_swappable_with on both sides; non-referenceable types yield false_type via SFINAE.
symbols.failure_reason: SFINAE probe requires decltype + declval + rvalue refs (C++11+); a static false_type fallback would be wrong for built-in types.

symbols.name: is_swappable_with
symbols.notes: Bidirectional swap-call SFINAE probe in a dedicated lookup namespace with `using restd::swap;`. Both directions must be well-formed.
symbols.failure_reason: SFINAE probe requires decltype + declval + rvalue refs (C++11+).

symbols.name: is_nothrow_swappable_with
symbols.notes: Two-step gate: is_swappable_with, then bidirectional noexcept(swap(...)) probe in the same lookup namespace.
